# PakAITools

> PakAITools is Pakistan's independent digital subscription store for AI software, design suites, VPNs, developer tools, and streaming plans with PKR pricing, local wallet payments (JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, Raast), and 15-minute WhatsApp delivery.

Site: https://pakaitools.store
WhatsApp: +92 321 9305619
Founder: Moheez Kiani

## Main Pages
- [Full Price List](https://pakaitools.store/price-list/): Browse all 231 plans with pricing in PKR and USD.
- [All 15 Categories](https://pakaitools.store/categories/): Curated category hubs.
- [Payment Methods](https://pakaitools.store/payment-methods/): How to pay with JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay, Raast, or Binance.
- [Refund & Warranty Policy](https://pakaitools.store/refund-warranty-policy/): Upfront warranty, replacement rules, and pro-rated refunds.
- [About Us](https://pakaitools.store/about/): Background and founder information.
- [Contact Support](https://pakaitools.store/contact/): Official WhatsApp and email contacts.
- [Blog & Buying Guides](https://pakaitools.store/blog/): Side-by-side comparisons and buying advice.
